correctness.rationale: For fixed even s≥4, γ in (d_s,δ_*), positivity of source spectral r_A^(m)(γ) gives a chain α_0,...,α_m with α_i≥d_s for i≥2 and all preceding α_i < u=(1−q)/2, q=(2^(s(1/s−h₂(γ)))−1)^(1/s). The cited Fagnani–Ravazzi transition inequality gives at most −η per middle transition with η=−d_s/2 log₂(1−q²)>0, while r_A^(2)≤1 and the final transition≤0. Thus r_A^(m)(γ)≤1−(m−3)η; m≥4+floor(1/η) contradicts r_A>0. Taylor expansion yields M_s(δ_*−Δ)∼(2 ln2/d_s)[s ln((1−δ_*)/δ_*)]^(−2/s) Δ^(−2/s). This is a sufficient round bound, not an optimum. Numeric checker only corroborates constants, not for-all-s proof.
